say:0:1012719301:0.text: My loyal warriors! Have no fear! Our victory is assured!
say:0:1012719301:0.source_cn: 我忠诚的战士们，不必畏惧！胜利的曙光会照耀你们！
say:0:1012719301:0.male: My loyal warriors! Have no fear! Our victory is assured!
say:0:1012719301:0.female: My loyal warriors! Have no fear! Our victory is assured!

say:1:1012719302:0.text: Eomir! You toad-eating coward! Come face me!
say:1:1012719302:0.source_cn: 伊米尔！你这只缩头乌龟，赶紧给我滚到前面来！
say:1:1012719302:0.male: Eomir! You toad-eating coward! Come face me!
say:1:1012719302:0.female: Eomir! You toad-eating coward! Come face me!
